programme.desc: Karen Mills has made a career out of making people laugh. She's been a nationally touring comedian for 25 years and can be heard daily on Sirius / XM comedy channels. Karen has appeared on ABC, GAC and most recently on season 12 of America's Got Talent. Karen has a straight-forward approach to the realities of life. Her smart, funny, keen observations will keep you laughing at yourself as you relate to her experiences.

programme.title: Adam Carolla
programme.desc: Outspoken podcast king and comedian Adam Carolla brings his unique humor to Dry Bar. He delivers his first clean act as he gets real about the absurdities of modern day parenting, unsuccessful rebrands, and what the rich and poor have in common.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: There's no doubt Keith Barany delivers the laughs, every single time he hits the stage. As a tested and veteran touring pro, Keith could explain for hours about the subtle skill set he employs to make the laughs happen. But all you need to know is…he's one of the strongest adult audience PG-rated comedy headliners in North America. Keith has appeared on numerous TV shows including Politically Incorrect, The Jimmy Kimmel show, The Emmys, and Seinfeld. He has opened for Jerry Seinfeld, Ray Romano, Jon Stewart, Louie CK, Ray Charles, and Bob Hope, to name a few. Keith has toured internationally nine times including Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Central America, US territories overseas and some places the Pentagon won't let him mention!

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Johnny Beehner puts on a funny show. He's got everything you want from a comic: He's silly, he's likeable, and he's fun. With a background in improvisational theater including training at Chicago's prestigious Second City, as well as the Upright Citizens Brigade in Los Angeles, Johnny brings a unique style to the stage. Beehner made his network television debut in January of 2015 as one of the last comedians to appear on the Late Show with David Letterman. He has made numerous appearances on FOX "Laughs" television show, and regularly appears on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Show. His comedy can be heard regularly on XM/ Sirius Satellite radio. Other notable and accomplishments of Johnny's include winning First place in Comcast's 2014 season of "Trial By Laughter," placing third in the 2014 “Laughing Skull Comedy Festival” of Atlanta, and making it to the finals in the 2012 “Great American Comedy Festival”. He was named one of Ricky Gervais' Top 5 picks in the "Just Sayin” stand up contest. Johnny was recently named one of 2015's Top10, "Hot Comics to Watch" by his wife. She says that he would have a shot at the #1 spot if he would “work just a little bit harder”. He's a married man, a new dad, and his current life goal is to win just one argument with his beautiful wife.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Un reconocido chef de Londres disfruta del éxito profesional hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo y abrir un pequeño restaurante en el campo. Así conocerá a Kate, una crítica gastronómica, que le ayudará a creer nuevamente en el amor.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott, ahora autora de un libro de autoayuda, regresa a casa en Woodsboro, última etapa de la gira promocional. programme.title: El Espejo Distorsionado del Alma
programme.desc: ¿Cómo sobrevivir cuando tu propio hermano, con el entusiasta apoyo de tu hermana, te vende para pagar sus deudas? ¿Cómo seguir adelante cuando todos a tu alrededor te señalan y gritan, y ni siquiera tus propios padres se interesan por ti? ¿Acaso una falsa acusación de intento de asesinato te empujará al borde de la desesperación? Pero ¿será un pequeño relicario con una foto dentro, último recuerdo de un pasado entrañable, suficiente para ayudarte a soportar esta miseria y sobrevivir a tu tormento?

programme.title: Mami Nunca Te Haría Daño
programme.desc: Riley no quiere otra cosa sino reconstruir la relación con su madre y su hermana pequeña, que están enclaustradas debido a la enfermedad de su hermana. Pero cuando Riley nota que su hermana puede no estar tan enferma como parece, su madre se da cuenta y no se detendrá ante nada para mantener a sus hijas con ella para siempre.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Teresa Cristina insulta a Griselda y la humilla diciéndole que se ilusiona en vano con su marido. Reinaldo visita a Griselda, se disculpa, intenta consolarla, pero acaban despidiéndose para siempre. Bárbara presiona a Máximo para que vuelva a pelear.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Griselda sigue en estado depresivo en la cama, cuando aparece Gabriel con la noticia de que ella es la ganadora del premio mayor de la lotería. Teresa Cristina y Reinaldo hacen el amor luego de discutir acaloradamente por Griselda. Él la extraña.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Verónica le regresa el niño a Lucecita. Alejandro va a la tumba de Gabriela y Verónica lo escucha decir cuánto todavía la extraña y la ama. Ella siente nostalgia. Antonia está tensa y ordena la muerte de Julio, que ya sabe que Gabriela está viva.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Julio repite el nombre de Gabriela Suárez mientras agoniza, pero no alcanza a decir que ella es Verónica Dantés. Antonia se va quedando cada vez más sola y Poncia se lo hace notar. Alejandro sabe que su mamá no siente nada por la muerte de Montemar.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Verónica no quiere que Alejandro se vaya del pueblo. Él aprovecha la oportunidad para repetirle que la ama. En una misión especial a San Pedro, el comisionado Balmaceda tiene su primer enfrentamiento con Antonia. Ricardo trata su problema de impotencia.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Antonia es sacada de su hacienda esposada; Balmaceda es obligado a llevársela cargándola. Verónica le da pistas al comisionado acerca de Guerra. Lucho teme que el mismo policía que lo llevó a prisión descubra todo. David es sorprendido con su novia.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.title: FishON! | "Trophy Walleye Adventure on Pierre Lake"
programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.
